stem: Which sentence from the story shows that Cody thinks the Red team players are better than Mud?

options.label: A
options.text: Now the entire Red team ran at Mud. (paragraph 8)

options.label: B
options.text: If Mud was lucky, he might avoid being knocked to the ground. (paragraph 9)

options.label: C
options.text: Cody wondered when Mud had gotten so fast. (paragraph 13)

options.label: D
options.text: Mud spun away, twisting out of range just as Mahender kicked for the ball. (paragraph 14)
